title: Decision: workspace.dependencies centralization
description: All external dependencies (axum, tokio, serde, etc.) are versioned once in [workspace.dependencies], and all crates reference them with version.workspace = true or .workspace = true. This prevents the monorepo from fragmenting into different versions of the same crate—a critical guardrail against subtle bugs from competing versions of tokio, serde, or rustls in the same process.
notes: opinion: no engineering basis — this is a rationale note affirming a correct existing decision (centralized workspace.dependencies). Not a complaint or finding. No action needed.
